🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX (1W: -7.29% | 1M: -8.09%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling and Stocks vs Bonds (Level: 9.3136; 1W: +2.13% | 1M: +4.26%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising, with HYG (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +0.23%) ABOVE TREND providing credit support.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -7.29% | 1M: -8.09%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Credit supportive but mixed: HYG (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +0.23%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.39% | 1M: -0.79%) RECOVERY. Stocks vs Bonds driving flow: SPY (1W: +3.62% | 1M: +3.11%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-easing: Dollar UUP proxy (Level: 28.19; 1W: +0.07% | 1M: -0.60%) → flat RECOVERY and Yield Curve (Level: 1.0088; 1W: +0.67% | 1M: -2.11%) → flat RECOVERY, keeping conditions supportive for risk assets.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech leading with momentum: XLK (1W: +5.46% | 1M: +2.17%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising and Financials showing cyclical strength: XLF (1W: +1.79% | 1M: +6.89%) ABOVE TREND — style: Growth/Momentum leading. Defensives lag: XLU (1W: -2.72% | 1M: -4.22%) BELOW TREND.

5. US vs Global?
US outperformance: SPY (1W: +3.62% | 1M: +3.11%) ABOVE TREND while China soft near-term: FXI (1W: -1.56% | 1M: +7.51%) CORRECTION and EM mixed: EEM (1W: +2.25% | 1M: -1.83%) RECOVERY.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Small/modest speculation: IWM (1W: +1.93% | 1M: +1.63%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +3.88% | 1M: -5.53%) RECOVERY show selective risk-taking; IBIT (1W: -0.57% | 1M: +3.58%) CORRECTION — appetite present but measured.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Industrial/metals strength: CPER (1W: +3.61% | 1M: +9.95%) ABOVE TREND and PALL (1W: +4.36% | 1M: +12.32%) ABOVE TREND; Gold/Silver supportive: GLD (1W: +3.32% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND, SLV (1W: +4.39% | 1M: +5.72%) ABOVE TREND.

8. Energy Trend?
Mixed energy signal: XLE (1W: -1.36% | 1M: +4.60%) CORRECTION and BNO (1W: -4.61% | 1M: +8.72%) CORRECTION, while natural gas UNG (1W: -3.80% | 1M: -16.98%) BELOW TREND — cyclical demand story intact but volatile.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: SPY (1W + / 1M +) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W + / 1M +) ABOVE TREND align with VXX down — consistent risk-on signals. Divergences MINOR: XLE, BNO, FXI and IBIT show 1W vs 1M mismatch (CORRECTION flags) but no MAJOR divergence across core ETFs.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposures that capture growth/momentum (XLK, QQQ) while monitoring cyclicals (XLF, XLI) for continued strength; reduce exposure to clear defensives/utilities like XLU and weak natural gas (UNG). Bonds neutral-to-monitor: TLT (1W: +0.06% | 1M: -1.79%) RECOVERY.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +5.46% | 1M: +2.17%) ABOVE TREND; XME (1W: +8.33% | 1M: +8.25%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLU (1W: -2.72% | 1M: -4.22%) BELOW TREND; UNG (1W: -3.80% | 1M: -16.98%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: CPER (1W: +3.61% | 1M: +9.95%) ABOVE TREND; SLV (1W: +4.39% | 1M: +5.72%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: BNO (1W: -4.61% | 1M: +8.72%) CORRECTION; UNG (1W: -3.80% | 1M: -16.98%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold); HYG/LQD ~0.75 (credit health pivot); SPY/TLT ~9.3 (stocks vs bonds momentum), Tech/Financials ratio ~3.2 (leadership pivot to monitor).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, VXX falling and Stocks vs Bonds rising confirm risk appetite. Tech and cyclicals showing relative strength (XLK ABOVE TREND; XLF ABOVE TREND). Key risk: commodity/energy divergences (XLE/BNO/UNG CORRECTION-BELOW TREND) and several 1W vs 1M corrections to monitor.
